Paragraph:
Translation: There are personalities like yourself, Bhisma, Karna, Krpa, Asvatthama, Vikarna and the son of Somadatta called Bhurisrava, who are always victorious in battle.

Purport (Excerpt): Duryodhana mentioned the exceptional heroes in the battle, all of whom are ever-victorious. Vikarna is the brother of Duryodhana, Asvatthama is the son of Dronacarya, and Saumadatti, or Bhurisrava, is the son of the King of the Bahlikas. Karna is the half brother of Arjuna... Krpacarya married the twin sister of Dronacarya.
Situation/Problem_Faced: After being overwhelmed by the strength of the opposing army, Duryodhana attempts to steady his mind and reassure his commander by taking inventory of the legendary, 'ever-victorious' warriors on his own side.
Key_Teaching/Action_Taken: Duryodhana specifically names the most elite and historically undefeated stalwarts in the Kaurava army. By praising Dronacarya ('yourself') and others, he attempts to build camaraderie and boost the collective morale.
Outcome/Resolution: He temporarily constructs a mental shield against his own anxiety, using the formidable reputations of his allies to convince himself of their impending success.

Spiritual_Psychological_Concept_Indian.Concept: Ahamkara (Ego-driven reliance on external power and material reputations)
Moha (The illusion that worldly strength and past victories guarantee future success, regardless of righteousness)

Brief_Summary_Spiritual: Duryodhana seeks refuge in material might. He calculates his chances of success based entirely on the worldly reputations of his generals, failing to understand the spiritual principle that even 'ever-victorious' warriors cannot ultimately triumph when aligned with adharma (unrighteousness).
Brief_Summary_Psychological: This is a clear example of self-soothing through positive reinforcement. To counter his intense anxiety and feelings of inadequacy, Duryodhana engages in cognitive reframing by focusing solely on his assets. By listing these highly capable individuals, he attempts to emotionally regulate himself and project an image of secure leadership.
